rationale: SNRI-to-SSRI swap, often when noradrenergic adverse effects predominate or response was insufficient. Duloxetine's high discontinuation-syndrome risk requires a graded reduction; sertraline is started low and titrated. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start sertraline 25 mg. Hold duloxetine 60 mg.
Halve duloxetine to 30 mg. Increase sertraline to 50 mg. Watch for discontinuation symptoms.
Hold duloxetine. Increase sertraline to 100 mg target.
Stop duloxetine. Continue sertraline 100 mg. Slow this final step if disc symptoms emerge.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: duloxetine 60 mg ≈ sertraline 100 mg (Maudsley 14th). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
